subject: Animation
title: Steamboat Willie Changes Everything
description: Learn Steamboat Willie Changes Everything in one minute.

hook.text: In 1928, a cartoon mouse whistled on a steamboat while perfectly synchronized music played along.

buildup.text: Walt Disney's Steamboat Willie was not the first sound cartoon, but its timing was flawless.

discovery.text: Mickey Mouse matched every movement to the soundtrack. It felt like the character was alive.

twist.text: Disney almost went bankrupt making it. No distributor wanted a cartoon with synchronized sound.

climax.text: When it finally screened in New York, audiences erupted. Sound animation had arrived for good.

punchline.text: A whistling mouse launched the Disney empire.

quiz.question: What made Steamboat Willie revolutionary?
options: It was the first cartoon ever made
It featured perfectly synchronized sound matched to character movement
It was the first color cartoon
